positioning: Client Command Deck is the white-label autonomous business command deck template: public site, admin command room, client OS, brain runtime, proof governance, and deployment-ready Cloudflare paths.
sales_rule: Lead with the buyer's operating pain, then send the one surface that proves the relevant capability. Keep owner setup, secrets, admin playbooks, and deployment internals out of buyer-facing answers.

surfaces.name: Client Command Deck Home
surfaces.purpose: Shows the client-facing operating-system website: command story, cabinet structure, leader roster, services, proof lanes, and deployment posture.
surfaces.sales_use: Use first when a prospect needs to understand that this is a business command deck, not a normal website.

surfaces.name: 16-Brain Runtime
surfaces.purpose: Shows Site Operator, Security Gate Brain, Central Command, and 13 cabinet executive brains with scoped lanes and guardrails.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a buyer asks who actually handles sales, client success, proof, security, operations, or technical work.

surfaces.name: Local Brain Router
surfaces.purpose: Routes buyer, proof, pricing, security, delivery, and cabinet questions to the right brain without requiring a paid model.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a prospect wants to feel how the command layer answers practical business questions.

surfaces.name: Sales Enablement Command Library
surfaces.purpose: Discovery, objection handling, demo scripting, follow-up, proposal support, and proof packet surfaces.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a buyer asks how the system helps the company sell and follow up consistently.

surfaces.name: Client OS
surfaces.audience: service businesses, client success teams, operators
surfaces.purpose: Client onboarding, document requests, status boards, escalation handling, renewal review, and proof loops.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a business loses track of client work after the sale.

surfaces.name: Brain Governance Proof Layer
surfaces.purpose: Scopes, tests, freshness ledgers, escalation rules, and safety boundaries for the 16 operating brains.
surfaces.sales_use: Use when a buyer needs to see governance and proof discipline before trusting the system.

public_claim_boundary: Say the client deployment includes a public site, command deck, 16-brain runtime, admin lane, proof routing, and governance surfaces.
Say the Security Gate Brain reviews tenant-sensitive, admin-sensitive, public-claim, and connector-sensitive paths before escalation.
Do not expose admin tokens, database URLs, mirror secrets, provider keys, or private setup instructions.
Do not promise autonomous legal, hiring, payment, tax, regulated compliance, or public-claim execution without human approval and professional review.
